# Disable or Enable the Ask AI option<AvailableFrom v="4.0.407" />

If the Cmd + I shortcut of the Ask AI modal conflicts with your Studio, you can disable it using this.

## CLI flag

```text
--disable-ask-ai
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)
- [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions)
- [`remotion bundle`](/docs/cli/bundle)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)
- [`remotion lambda sites create`](/docs/lambda/cli/sites/create)
- [`remotion cloudrun sites create`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/sites/create)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`bundle()`](/docs/bundle#askaienabled)
- [`deploySite()`](/docs/cloudrun/deploysite#askaienabled)
- [`deploySite()`](/docs/lambda/deploysite#askaienabled)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setAskAIEnabled(false);
```
